items.title: Chuck Israels interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 11, 2021
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] In fact I found this rather odd quote, Humphrey Lyttelton wrote it in 1965. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, we’re on it.

ctx.x: I’m working on a book so I’m verbally oriented at the moment. And yet it never really, it doesn’t substitute for hearing the music.

That’s true. It’s true absolutely. Music is something that is very hard to pin down but people try. In fact I found this rather odd quote, Humphrey Lyttelton wrote it in 1965. He did a show called “Jazz 625.” © Fillius Jazz Archive -12-
Oh, we’re on it. There’s all those —
